fomod.Name: BeastHHBB and iBeasts - Project ja-Kha'jay Patch
fomod.Description: Fixes headless or wrong-faced Khajiit when Project ja-Kha'jay is installed with iBeasts - Interesting Npcs replacer and BeastHHBB. You choose in the installer whose look (race, head, face, hair, skin, outfit) 40 shared NPCs get: BeastHHBB and iBeasts (default; iBeasts for 27 Interesting NPCs Khajiit, BeastHHBB for the 11 caravan Khajiit, Mazaka and J'zargo) or Project ja-Kha'jay. The patch keeps that look in front whatever order LOOT sorts the plugins in. All other record data (factions, AI, USSEP fixes) is kept from Project ja-Kha'jay. Plugin only: the mods of the chosen look must win file conflicts in your mod manager, iBeasts vs the Project ja-Kha'jay Addon and BeastHHBB vs Project ja-Kha'jay. Optional support, offered by the installer when installed: Hand to Hand - Trainers and Skill Books Addon.
